definitions.explanation: Vibrations that travel through air or other media and can be heard. Includes all kinds of sounds, from music to everyday noises.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえました。
{音|おと}を{小|ちい}さくしてください。
{外|そと}から{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえます。{何|なん}の{音|おと}でしょう。
examples.english: I can hear sounds from outside. I wonder what they are.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{音|おと}がよく{聞|き}こえます。{静|しず}かにしてください。
examples.english: Sound carries well in this room. Please be quiet.

notes: Different from {声|こえ} (voice) which specifically refers to sounds made by humans or animals. {音|おと} is for general sounds. Related compounds: {音楽|おんがく} (music), {足音|あしおと} (footsteps), {音声|おんせい} (audio/voice).
